games.title: The Contaminated City
games.place: A wide river city, three days after a freight-yard fire.
games.role: Chief Scientific Officer · Riverton Contamination Response
games.drama: A freight yard beside the river burned last night, and nobody can say what came off it. You are the city's Chief Scientific Officer, which means what gets measured — and what the city is told about it — is decided by you. Two neighbourhoods are downwind of a plume nobody has identified.
concepts: Atomic structure, ions and electron configuration
Kinetic molecular theory, diffusion and volatility
Thermochemistry: enthalpy, calorimetry, energy balance
Colligative properties
Concentration units and conversions: ppm, mg/L, molarity

games.title: The Contaminated City
games.course: Matter, mixtures and clean water · physical science
games.place: A wide river city, three days after a freight-yard fire.
games.role: Chief Scientific Officer · Riverton Contamination Response
games.drama: A freight yard beside the river burned last night, and nobody can say what came off it. You are the city's chief scientist, which means you decide what gets measured, and what the city gets told. Two neighbourhoods sit downwind of a cloud nobody has named.
concepts: Everything is made of matter, and matter comes in solids, liquids and gases
Dilution: adding water lowers the concentration and not the amount
A blank and a standard: how a laboratory knows a number is real
Acids and bases, and why the middle is where things are stable
Saying what you know and how well you know it

games.title: Red Sand
games.place: A propellant plant on Mars: modules buried in regolith along one track, under a butterscotch sky.
games.drama: Everyone here goes home on a rocket, and the rocket can only leave when Mars and Earth line up. That happens once every twenty-six months. The next one is sixteen months off.
concepts: Stoichiometry as a feed rate: turning a production target into kilograms in
Rate constants, and how steeply they climb with temperature
Electrolysis: driving a reaction that will not run on its own
Intermolecular forces, and why they set a boiling point
What an assay is for, and what a specification is a list of

games.title: Headwater
games.place: Ashfell Dam from the inside — galleries, a gate chamber, and a hundred metres of air off the crest.
games.drama: Ashfell Dam holds ninety-two million cubic metres of water in a gorge, with four villages along the river below it. This morning the reservoir is at 88% after the driest summer in nine years. The forecast is nine days of rain starting Thursday, over every hillside that drains into it.
concepts: Limits, one-sided limits, and where a limit fails to exist
Related rates
The definite integral as an accumulation, and its units
Exponential growth and decay, and half-life
Reading a quantity off the graph of its own derivative

games.title: The Trial
games.place: One long floor, where walking north is distance from the patient.
games.drama: CLARION-3 has been running for four years: 2,400 people across thirty-one hospitals, half of them getting a new drug and half the usual treatment. Nobody in this building knows which patient got which.
concepts: Why a comparison needs a control arm at all
Hard endpoints against judged ones, and blinded adjudication
Multiplicity: every extra look and every extra slice costs something
Confidence intervals: what a point estimate does not say
Consent, and the obligations a trial keeps to the people in it

games.title: Sightline
games.place: A hall with a street corner built across one end, and the identification distance painted on the floor.
games.drama: Elias Ward has served seven years of fourteen for a robbery a stranger watched from the far pavement of Ferrier Street on a November night in 2019. One witness, no forensic evidence, and a file nobody has read end to end since the verdict.
concepts: Acuity as an angle: what the eye can resolve falls off with distance
Encoding: memory is built at the moment, from what was attended to
Arousal and encoding: the amygdala, cortisol and the inverted U
Post-identification feedback and confidence inflation
False confession: minimisation, maximisation and the innocent person's arithmetic

games.title: Quantum
games.place: A laboratory spine that is a temperature gradient, walked end to end.
games.drama: Ridgeway runs a quantum processor: twelve qubits, held a hundredth of a degree above absolute zero by a refrigerator the size of a wardrobe. Everyone calls it the fridge. You lead the group.
concepts: Energy quantisation, and why a level spacing sets everything else
Resonance, detuning, and finding a qubit frequency
The microwave chain: attenuation, amplification and noise temperature
The standard quantum limit, and beating it with squeezing
Provenance of data, and what a shared calibration hides

games.title: Bring Them Home
games.place: Mission Control: four tiers stepping down to a wall of plot boards. The teams are rows, not rooms.
games.drama: Three people are in a spacecraft on the far side of a quarter-million miles, and something aboard has just exploded. You are the flight director, and the calls are yours to make. Power is falling.
concepts: Vectors and components
Torque and moment of inertia
Series, parallel and load management
Springs and Hooke's law
Graphical analysis of motion data

games.title: Bring Them Home
games.course: Motion, energy and staying alive · physical science
games.place: Mission Control: four tiers stepping down to a wall of plot boards. The teams are rows, not rooms.
games.drama: Three people are in a spacecraft on the far side of a quarter-million miles, and something aboard has just exploded. You are the flight director, and the calls are yours to make. Power is falling.
concepts: Speed, distance and time, and how they give each other
Rates: how fast something is used up, and how long it lasts
Circuits: a break, a short, and why a battery has limits
Reading a graph and spotting what changed at the moment it changed
Ordering work when several things are wrong at once

games.title: Deep Watch
games.place: A submarine — one line of ten compartments, hatches between them, and no sky at all.
games.role: Reasoning Under Pressure Beneath the Surface
games.drama: You have the watch on a submarine at ninety metres. Everybody aboard is asleep, on watch, or working in a compartment they cannot see out of. Neither can you.
concepts: Sound as a wave: frequency, wavelength, speed
Bearings, triangulation and geometry
Gas laws and life support
Diffraction, beamwidth and array directivity
Human factors: checklists, handover and communication

games.title: Deep Watch
games.course: Sound, floating and sinking · physical science
games.place: A submarine — one line of ten compartments, hatches between them, and no sky at all.
games.role: Reasoning Under Pressure Beneath the Surface
games.drama: You have the watch on a submarine, ninety metres down. Nobody aboard can see out, and neither can you. What you know about the water comes from listening.
concepts: Sound is a wave, and it travels through water as well as air
Hearing something quiet next to something loud
Heat moves from hot to cold, and it needs a path
A rate: how fast something builds up or drains away
Two instruments that share a source are really one instrument

games.title: Project Y
games.place: A mesa laboratory in 1943. Chalkboards and typed sheets, and no screens anywhere.
games.drama: It is April 1943, and the site is three weeks old: a boys' school on a mesa in New Mexico, with a laboratory going up around it. There is a fence, and most of the people arriving cannot tell their families where they are. You are a scientist newly assigned to Project Y.
concepts: Nuclear structure: protons, neutrons, isotopes, nuclide notation
Criticality: mass, geometry, reflectors, moderation
Units and conversions: MeV, u, barns, scientific notation
Inverse-square law for radiation intensity
Criticality safety: administrative limits and controls

games.title: Blackout
games.place: Calder Switching Station, and two circuits of lattice towers walking off the edge of the map.
games.drama: Four million people are supplied from the Calder network, and the whole of it runs on one number. Mains frequency has to stay within half a hertz of fifty. Drift further and generators start tripping off, which takes the rest of the system with them.
concepts: Charge, current, voltage and resistance
Reactance, impedance and phasors
Faraday's law and electromagnetic induction
Fault current and short-circuit analysis
Load shedding as a decision under uncertainty

games.title: Blackout
games.course: Circuits, energy and the grid · physical science
games.place: Calder Switching Station, and two circuits of lattice towers walking off the edge of the map.
games.drama: Four million people are supplied from the Calder network, and the whole of it runs on one number. Mains frequency has to stay within half a hertz of fifty. Drift further and generators start tripping off, which takes the rest of the system with them.
concepts: A circuit is a loop, and a break anywhere stops it
Current through something makes heat, and that is why wires have limits
A graph of demand across a day, and why the peak matters
Something can be protected too eagerly, and cost you the supply
Deciding while the picture is incomplete

games.title: Aftershock
games.place: Kestrel Bay three days after, where the fault broke the surface and you can walk the scarp.
games.drama: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake hit Kestrel Bay three days ago and the town is still standing, unevenly. You are the building safety coordinator, which means you decide which buildings people are allowed back into: green to enter, yellow for restricted use, red for nobody.
concepts: P and S waves, and what the gap between them measures
Natural period, and resonance between building and ground
Bearing capacity and settlement
Non-structural hazards — what falls before the frame does
Documentation: the record somebody inherits

games.title: Aftershock
games.course: Earthquakes and building safety · Earth science
games.place: Kestrel Bay three days after, where the fault broke the surface and you can walk the scarp.
games.drama: An earthquake hit Kestrel Bay three days ago. The town is still standing, unevenly. You are the building safety coordinator, which means you say which buildings people may go back into.
concepts: Plates move, and a fault is the crack where they slip past each other
The ground itself changes the shaking: soft ground shakes more
Measure it more than once, and average the readings
One sample is not the whole building
An instrument that is wrong needs a check from something else

games.title: Planetary Defense
games.place: A mountain ridge: one road, domes with open shutters, a thirty-metre dish and red service lamps.
games.drama: A survey telescope flagged a faint moving point near the ecliptic four hours ago. Four hours of observation is not enough to pin down an orbit, and some of the orbits that fit the data so far pass through the Earth.
concepts: Celestial coordinates and angular measure
Orbital elements and orbit determination
Probability, risk and expected value
Thermal emission and infrared temperature
Crater and blast scaling; ground effects

games.title: Planetary Defense
games.place: A mountain ridge: one road, domes with open shutters, a thirty-metre dish and red service lamps.
games.drama: Four hours ago a survey telescope found a faint dot moving against the stars. Four hours is not long enough to know where it is going, and some of the paths that fit go through the Earth. You run the campaign.
concepts: Telling a real object from an artefact, by repeating the observation
Scale and distance in the solar system
Choosing the measurement that tells two explanations apart
Rotation, and a pattern that repeats in a measurement
Independent checks: a second method that could disagree

games.title: Safety Factor
games.place: Seven rides at Corbin Park, and an inspector who will not take a number nobody can derive.
games.drama: Corbin Park lost its certificate in October and the season opens in three weeks. Seven rides have to get it back — a coaster, a wheel, a drop tower, a pirate ship, a carousel, a bumper floor and a log flume — and the signature on all seven documents is yours.
concepts: Velocity against speed: direction is part of the quantity
What supplies the centripetal force in each case — a rail, a chain, a seat
Momentum, and its conservation in a collision
The small-angle approximation, and where it stops being true
Wind load, and why the last few metres a second cost the most

games.title: Ice Core
games.place: A deep-drilling camp on a polar plateau, with the flattest, emptiest horizon in the set.
games.drama: Vestri Dome is a drilling camp on the polar plateau: six huts up on legs, a trench with a tower over it, and two and a half kilometres of ice already pulled out of the ground. None of it can be let above minus twenty.
concepts: Why ice keeps a record at all: burial without melting
Stable isotopes as a thermometer: δ¹⁸O and deuterium
Dust and tephra: aridity, wind and where the dust came from
Core logging, orientation and chain of custody
Reporting an uncertain record: what it licenses and what it does not

games.title: Ice Core
games.course: Layers, records and climate · Earth science
games.place: A deep-drilling camp on a polar plateau, with the flattest, emptiest horizon in the set.
games.drama: Vestri Dome is a drilling camp on the polar plateau: six huts up on legs, a trench with a tower over it, and two and a half kilometres of ice already pulled out of the ground. None of it can be let above minus twenty.
concepts: Snow that never melts piles up in layers, one year at a time
Something measured today can stand in for something nobody measured then
Reading a graph: what the axes say, and what the wiggles mean
Two records that agree are stronger than one that is longer
Cold, power and daylight are the limits a polar camp works inside

games.title: Outbreak: Riverton
games.place: A hospital campus in week three: triage marquees, container labs, and a fence with one gate.
games.drama: Three hospitals in one river city reported the same unusual illness inside a day of each other, and the ambulances are still arriving. Seven patients, four days, and the same four symptoms in every one of them.
concepts: Cell structure and function
Mutation and genetic variation
Epidemiology: case definitions, curves, R and reservoirs
Gene regulation and expression control
Epidemic modelling and projection

games.title: Outbreak: Riverton
games.course: Germs, spread and public health · life science
games.place: A hospital campus in week three: triage marquees, container labs, and a fence with one gate.
games.drama: Three hospitals in one river city have reported the same strange illness within a day of each other. The ambulances are still arriving. Seven patients, four days, and the same four symptoms every time.
concepts: Some illnesses are caused by living things too small to see
A graph of cases over time, and what its shape says
Comparing a group who had something with a group who did not
Germs change, and a change can beat a treatment
Deciding while the answer is still unknown

games.title: Wellmere
games.place: A breeding station on a headland, ringed by isolation distance. Sea on three sides and one causeway in.
games.drama: Two hundred kilometres east there is a wheat disease the breeding programme has exactly one gene against. The wind that would carry it here comes in over the causeway. You are Season Lead at Wellmere.
concepts: Seed viability as a rate: what a stored seed is still doing
Linkage and recombination: distance on a chromosome as a probability
Founder effects and bottlenecks in a stored collection
Regression to the mean, and why the best plot flatters itself
In situ against ex situ conservation, and what each preserves

games.title: Wellmere
games.course: Traits, inheritance and breeding · life science
games.place: A breeding station on a headland, ringed by isolation distance. Sea on three sides and one causeway in.
games.drama: Two hundred kilometres east there is a wheat disease the breeding programme has exactly one gene against. The wind that would carry it here comes in over the causeway. You are Season Lead at Wellmere.
concepts: Living things pass traits to their offspring
Counting the offspring, and comparing counts with what was expected
Repeats and averages: one plant proves nothing
Variety inside a collection, and why losing it is hard to undo
Deciding with a season that does not come round again

games.title: Hospital Heroes
games.place: A children's hospital ward — a spine with rooms off it, and everything a size larger.
games.drama: You are a new doctor at the children's hospital. Today is your first day on the ward. Children come in hurt, or sick, or scared.
concepts: Levels of organisation: cells, tissues, organs, systems
Heart and circulation
Hormones and growth
Joints and how far they move
Imaging: X-rays and pictures of the inside
